title: First Steps Helper: Absolute Value
description: Booklet Section 10.3 helper selecting the absolute value of adjustable input A.

walkthrough.title: Generate A
walkthrough.text: P1 is mapped through the full-range helper to create input A.

walkthrough.title: Create -A and compare with zero
walkthrough.text: INV2 forms -A. CMP1 compares A against ZERO.

walkthrough.title: Display absolute value
walkthrough.text: The positive branch is A and the non-positive branch is -A, so OUT Y shows abs(A).
